items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: me and George would play along with him... me and Howard played the whole dance with ourselves... I made a recording with, with, uh, with, uh, Kid Howard

ctx.x: In other words, you help each other out. That's what the idea is.

You see, that's, that's where Joy and Lou's band had such a good reputation, good name, you see? Anytime when, uh, Kid Howard was playing at a, at a solo, me and George would play along with him, you understand? Every, anytime George had a solo, me and Howard would play along with George. And every time I had a solo, they'd play along with me. And after we, you think, we'd turn the rhythm loose, you see? You know? They'd play one or two chords, then we'd all come on in together, you understand? Music, all goes…
So you'd kind of swap the lead around, huh? It's easy idea, and then everybody would keep working. I'd get the picture of them.
